lines.gurmukhi: ਨੀਲ ਵਸਤ੍ਰ ਪਹਿਰਿ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: neel vasatr pahir hovahi paravaan ||
lines.translation: Wearing blue robes, they seek the approval of the Muslim rulers.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਲੇਛ ਧਾਨੁ ਲੇ ਪੂਜਹਿ ਪੁਰਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: malechh dhaan le poojahi puraan ||
lines.translation: Accepting bread from the Muslim rulers, they still worship the Puraanas.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਭਾਖਿਆ ਕਾ ਕੁਠਾ ਬਕਰਾ ਖਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: abhaakhiaa kaa kuthaa bakaraa khaanaa ||
lines.translation: They eat the meat of the goats, killed after the Muslim prayers are read over them,

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਉਕੇ ਉਪਰਿ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: chauke upar kisai na jaanaa ||
lines.translation: but they do not allow anyone else to enter their kitchen areas.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇ ਕੈ ਚਉਕਾ ਕਢੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: de kai chaukaa kadhee kaar ||
lines.translation: They draw lines around them, plastering the ground with cow-dung.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਪਰਿ ਆਇ ਬੈਠੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: upar aai baithe kooRiaar ||
lines.translation: The false come and sit within them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਤੁ ਭਿਟੈ ਵੇ ਮਤੁ ਭਿਟੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: mat bhitai ve mat bhitai ||
lines.translation: They cry out, "Do not touch our food,

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਅੰਨੁ ਅਸਾਡਾ ਫਿਟੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu a(n)n asaadaa phitai ||
lines.translation: Or it will be polluted!"

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨਿ ਫਿਟੈ ਫੇੜ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: tan phitai pheR karen ||
lines.translation: But with their polluted bodies, they commit evil deeds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਜੂਠੈ ਚੁਲੀ ਭਰੇਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: man joothai chulee bharen ||
lines.translation: With filthy minds, they try to cleanse their mouths.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak sach dhiaaeeai ||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, meditate on the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਚਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: such hovai taa sach paaeeai ||2||
lines.translation: If you are pure, you will obtain the True Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਿਤੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਵੇਖਿ ਨਦਰੀ ਹੇਠਿ ਚਲਾਇਦਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: chitai a(n)dar sabh ko vekh nadaree heth chalaaidaa ||
lines.translation: All are within Your mind; You see and move them under Your Glance of Grace, O Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape de vadiaaeeaa aape hee karam karaaidaa ||
lines.translation: You Yourself grant them glory, and You Yourself cause them to act.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੁ ਵਡਾ ਵਡ ਮੇਦਨੀ ਸਿਰੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਦਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: vadahu vadaa vad medanee sire sir dha(n)dhai laaidaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord is the greatest of the great; great is His world. He enjoins all to their tasks.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਉਪਠੀ ਜੇ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਲਤਾਨਾ ਘਾਹੁ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: nadar upathee je kare sulataanaa ghaahu karaaidaa ||
lines.translation: If he should cast an angry glance, He can transform kings into blades of grass.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਿ ਮੰਗਨਿ ਭਿਖ ਨ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: dar ma(n)gan bhikh na paaidaa ||16||
lines.translation: Even though they may beg from door to door, no one will give them charity. ||16||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਮੋਹਾਕਾ ਘਰੁ ਮੁਹੈ ਘਰੁ ਮੁਹਿ ਪਿਤਰੀ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: je mohaakaa ghar muhai ghar muhi pitaree dei ||
lines.translation: The thief robs a house, and offers the stolen goods to his ancestors.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗੈ ਵਸਤੁ ਸਿਞਾਣੀਐ ਪਿਤਰੀ ਚੋਰ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: agai vasat sinjaaneeai pitaree chor karei ||
lines.translation: In the world hereafter, this is recognized, and his ancestors are considered thieves as well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਢੀਅਹਿ ਹਥ ਦਲਾਲ ਕੇ ਮੁਸਫੀ ਏਹ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vadheeahi hath dalaal ke musaphee eh karei ||
lines.translation: The hands of the go-between are cut off; this is the Lord's justice.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਗੈ ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਿ ਖਟੇ ਘਾਲੇ ਦੇਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak agai so milai j khate ghaale dei ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, in the world hereafter, that alone is received, which one gives to the needy from his own earnings and labor. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜੋਰੂ ਸਿਰਨਾਵਣੀ ਆਵੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu joroo siranaavanee aavai vaaro vaar ||
lines.translation: As a woman has her periods, month after month,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੂਠੇ ਜੂਠਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਵਸੈ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: joothe joothaa mukh vasai nit nit hoi khuaar ||
lines.translation: so does falsehood dwell in the mouth of the false; they suffer forever, again and again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਚੇ ਏਹਿ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ ਬਹਨਿ ਜਿ ਪਿੰਡਾ ਧੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sooche ehi na aakheeahi bahan j pi(n)daa dhoi ||
lines.translation: They are not called pure, who sit down after merely washing their bodies.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਚੇ ਸੇਈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sooche seee naanakaa jin man vasiaa soi ||2||
lines.translation: Only they are pure, O Nanak, within whose minds the Lord abides. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਰੇ ਪਲਾਣੇ ਪਉਣ ਵੇਗ ਹਰ ਰੰਗੀ ਹਰਮ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ture palaane paun veg har ra(n)gee haram savaariaa ||
lines.translation: With saddled horses, as fast as the wind, and harems decorated in every way;

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਠੇ ਮੰਡਪ ਮਾੜੀਆ ਲਾਇ ਬੈਠੇ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kothe ma(n)dap maaReeaa laai baithe kar paasaariaa ||
lines.translation: in houses and pavilions and lofty mansions, they dwell, making ostentatious shows.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੀਜ ਕਰਨਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਬੁਝਨਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: cheej karan man bhaavade har bujhan naahee haariaa ||
lines.translation: They act out their minds' desires, but they do not understand the Lord, and so they are ruined.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਸਿ ਖਾਇਆ ਵੇਖਿ ਮਹਲਤਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar phuramaais khaaiaa vekh mahalat maran visaariaa ||
lines.translation: Asserting their authority, they eat, and beholding their mansions, they forget about death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਰੁ ਆਈ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਹਾਰਿਆ ॥੧੭॥
lines.transliteration: jar aaee joban haariaa ||17||
lines.translation: But old age comes, and youth is lost. ||17||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕਰਿ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਮੰਨੀਐ ਸਭ ਤੈ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: je kar sootak ma(n)neeai sabh tai sootak hoi ||
lines.translation: If one accepts the concept of impurity, then there is impurity everywhere.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੋਹੇ ਅਤੈ ਲਕੜੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕੀੜਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gohe atai lakaRee a(n)dar keeRaa hoi ||
lines.translation: In cow-dung and wood there are worms.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇਤੇ ਦਾਣੇ ਅੰਨ ਕੇ ਜੀਆ ਬਾਝੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jete daane a(n)n ke jeeaa baajh na koi ||
lines.translation: As many as are the grains of corn, none is without life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲਾ ਪਾਣੀ ਜੀਉ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: pahilaa paanee jeeu hai jit hariaa sabh koi ||
lines.translation: First, there is life in the water, by which everything else is made green.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਤਕੁ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਰਖੀਐ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਪਵੈ ਰਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sootak kiu kar rakheeai sootak pavai rasoi ||
lines.translation: How can it be protected from impurity? It touches our own kitchen.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਏਵ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਉਤਾਰੇ ਧੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sootak ev na utarai giaan utaare dhoi ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, impurity cannot be removed in this way; it is washed away only by spiritual wisdom. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਾ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਕੂੜੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: man kaa sootak lobh hai jihavaa sootak kooR ||
lines.translation: The impurity of the mind is greed, and the impurity of the tongue is falsehood.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਖੀ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਵੇਖਣਾ ਪਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਅ ਪਰ ਧਨ ਰੂਪੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: akhee sootak vekhanaa par tri par dhan roop ||
lines.translation: The impurity of the eyes is to gaze upon the beauty of another man's wife, and his wealth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੰਨੀ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਕੰਨਿ ਪੈ ਲਾਇਤਬਾਰੀ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ka(n)nee sootak ka(n)n pai laaitabaaree khaahi ||
lines.translation: The impurity of the ears is to listen to the slander of others.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੰਸਾ ਆਦਮੀ ਬਧੇ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak ha(n)saa aadamee badhe jam pur jaahi ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the mortal's soul goes, bound and gagged to the city of Death. ||2||

lines.transliteration: mah 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੋ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabho sootak bharam hai doojai lagai jaai ||
lines.translation: All impurity comes from doubt and attachment to duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ja(n)man maranaa hukam hai bhaanai aavai jaai ||
lines.translation: Birth and death are subject to the Command of the Lord's Will; through His Will we come and go.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਾਣਾ ਪੀਣਾ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਹੈ ਦਿਤੋਨੁ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: khaanaa peenaa pavitr hai diton rijak sa(n)baahi ||
lines.translation: Eating and drinking are pure, since the Lord gives nourishment to all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak jinhee guramukh bujhiaa tinhaa sootak naahi ||3||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs, who understand the Lord, are not stained by impurity. ||3||
